caption: The drawing depicts a single spur with an attached leather strap. The spur itself is metallic, rendered in tones of gray and silver with etched geometric and floral patterns along its length. The U-shaped metal shank ends with a multi-pointed rowel (wheel), which is dark gray. A small metal chain connects parts of the spur. The leather strap is detailed in shades of brown and features floral tooling, with visible stitching and a decorative metal button. The entire object is positioned centrally against a plain, cream-colored background, with the artist's signature, W. R. Leigh, in the lower right. No additional objects or background elements are present in the composition.
title: Spur
